title: Domain terrain elevation-grid normalization

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root public exports for terrain elevation-grid normalization.

sourceOracles.coverage: Root public export behavior; no dedicated terrain behavior oracle exists in the pinned test suite.

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript comparison of grid-size inference, orientation normalization, elevation aliases, no-data and fallback flags, bounds, quality metadata, provenance cloning, Unicode metadata and validation errors.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact deep equality and JSON serialization
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for normalized coordinates, elevations, bounds and quality ratios
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point preservation
tolerances.errors: exact error name and message equality

parityDifferences: The strict TypeScript declarations describe the existing JavaScript terrain normalizer without adding runtime behavior.
engineeringFunctionality: Solver-neutral normalization of square terrain elevation grids into oriented cells with coordinates, bounds, quality metadata and serializable provenance.
